Disseminations of Reports / Conversations and inflated topic activity on Jhonlin Acquisition of BYAN

Conversations and inflated topic activity on Jhonlin Acquisition of BYAN

Published 27 October 2026

Ishak Martins, Adisty Ramadhani

Lokanetra Information Observatory

Haji IsamBangsa Indonesia#HajiIsamAkuisisi BYAN#JhonlinInfo

Download PDF

Introduction

From 15/10/2026 07:33 to 23/10/2026 06:59 GMT+7, X recorded 1,626 tweets from 884 unique accounts on the Jhonlin Acquisition of BYAN. The dataset uses the keywords Haji Isam, Bangsa Indonesia, #HajiIsam, Akuisisi BYAN and #JhonlinInfo.

This report covers tweet volume and engagement, account concentration, word and hashtag frequencies, the busiest hour, emotion labels on the top 10% of reactions, stance samples and evidence tiers.

Findings

  • The period holds 1,626 tweets from 884 unique accounts, with 167,590 likes, 44,303 retweets, 15,637 comments and 227,530 total engagement; the busiest hour is 21/10/2026 18:00 GMT+7 with 97 tweets.
  • Replies make up 797 tweets, original posts 575 and quotes 254; LaiElfrid leads accounts with 42 tweets, ViralinAJ4 40 and Nutri_sar1 30.
  • Top words are indonesia 1,113, haji 831, isam 829, bangsa 811 and msci 389; top hashtags are #hajiisam 203, #jhonlingroup 110, #gd_psn 110, #titikinformasi 110 and #byan 94.
  • Emotion labels on 163 tweets, the top 10% by reactions, show anger 39.9%, disgust 36.2%, trust 17.2% and joy 13.5%.
  • Stance labels on 406 tweets show H1 agrees 10.8%, disagrees 7.9% and not related 81.3%; H2 agrees 1.2%, disagrees 0.7% and not related 98.0%; H3 agrees 0.0%, disagrees 4.9% and not related 95.1%.
  • Evidence tiers over 884 accounts are T0 450, T1 192, T2 242 and T3 0, with 21 burst hours.

Remarks

The stance labels cover 406 tweets and emotion labels cover 163 tweets; both cover subsets of the 1,626 tweets. Evidence tiers record signals in this dataset; T3 0 records no account in the coordinated tier. They do not prove automation, payment or coordination. Watch later periods for changes in reply share, account concentration and tier counts.

Amplification

Source: Kestrel Parts D and E. 884 accounts. Tiers describe evidence found in this dataset. They are not a claim that an account is automated, paid or coordinated.

Evidence tiers

Accounts per evidence tier

T0No signals
450 accounts, 51%

Nothing in this corpus separates this account from ordinary participation.

T1Burst participation only
192 accounts, 22%

The account posted inside an amplification burst and nothing else fired. Never filtered: posting during a spike is what an interested human does too.

T2Metadata-suspicious
242 accounts, 27%

At least two independent evidence families fired (burst-exclusive posting, creation inside a creation burst, extreme profile metadata, high near-duplicate/self-repetition).

T3Coordinated
0 accounts, 0%

This account sits in a cluster that stayed outside the permutation null after FDR correction. The strongest evidence tier, and the only one the de-amplified corpus removes by default.
